system.description:
Target a square. If there are any [Hidden] characters in the targeted square, immediately remove their [Hidden] status. During each Cleanup Process, if there are any [Hidden] characters in the target square, you may apply the removal effect again. This effect lasts until the end of the scene.

A skill that summons Shrieker, an ancestor spirit that embodies the hustle and bustle of the forest. Mushrooms that scream like the roar of the wind warn of hidden existences.
